definitionProtocol: nativeTablesVersion=1 remains; optional tables[].statisticPlan requires nativeStatisticPlanVersion=2 capability
owner: Existing P8 writer/CAS/transaction/receipt with nativeStatistics full metadata variant. NativePlanSectionJson is part of the same DynamicFormTemplate config sections and version snapshots, not a new store.
scope: This pure plan contains enabled complete targets. The registered wire state adds identity-only disabled markers; incomplete/disabled settings remain in the local authoring session.

selectors.matrix: Ordered rowIds x fieldIds. Cell, row, column and range gestures freeze these ID lists at configuration time. No A1/index/name identity.
selectors.records: Ordered fieldIds with records=all. No per-report recordId in a reusable definition.
selectors.duplicateAddresses: Duplicate axis IDs are rejected; each selected address occurs once per target.
selectors.nonCartesianCellSet: Not yet represented. Do not approximate an irregular selection by its bounding rectangle.

grouping.selection: One group for the selected cells across the authorized source set.
grouping.column: One group per logical fieldId, including repeating tables.
grouping.cell: One group per matrix rowId+fieldId across reports.
grouping.record: Repeating tables only; expand to reportId+recordId. Never join independent records by index or label.

inputPolicy.all: All selected types must be accepted by each method in each group.
inputPolicy.types: Explicit type filter. Compiled groups retain excludedCellCount. Reject a group emptied by the filter.
inputPolicy.errors: Filtering selects definition types only; it must never hide a selected cell's invalid value.
inputPolicy.richText: Unsupported until an explicit typed text projection is implemented.

order.comparison: Ordinal ID comparison; frozen selector order. For sourceUpdatedAtAsc use the captured payload update time, then reportId ordinal as tie-break.
order.iteration: Source report order is outermost. In each report use selector traversal; repeat record IDs in declared order. For columnMajor repeating input, field order is outermost within that report.
order.pinGap: L5a.3 adds captured payload timestamp, immutable native source pins and source-order digest plus an explicit generation capture method. L5c must invoke capture with frozen authorized sources and persist/revalidate the digest through staging/publication/readback. Existing jobs do not opt in implicitly; missing time blocks time-ordered methods. No clock/ObjectId/cell-edit fallback.

methods.COUNT: Count present typed cells, including 0 and false; one multiSelect cell counts once. Missing/null/error never become 0 or false.
methods.DISTINCT_COUNT: Distinct typed whole-cell values; type participates in equality. Array order and full content are retained; no text sample limit.
methods.SUM: Numbers only, exact supported numeric domain; overflow is explicit.
methods.AVG: Numbers only; carry sum and numericCount through all hierarchy levels.
methods.MIN: One homogeneous number/date/fullDate type; compare values, not source recency. Date precision must also match within the runtime group; mixed year/month/day precision fails explicitly.
methods.MAX: One homogeneous number/date/fullDate type; compare values, not source recency. Date precision must also match within the runtime group; no invented first day/month.
methods.LATEST: One homogeneous type, requires sourceUpdatedAtAsc; choose the last present cell in the explicit total order. Not the last edited cell.
methods.BUCKET_COUNT: Explicit mode option/date. Choice requires homogeneous type and identical code/label sets within a group; a code contributes at most once per cell. Date mode keys exact typed date values, not an implicit month/year bucket.
methods.CONCAT: Literal separator plus separate itemSeparator, keep/skip blanks, keep/distinct full rendered segments, text/canonical format and code/label choice formatting. All options required; no defaults on read.
methods.STACK_ROWS: Append complete selected source blocks vertically. Columns follow frozen fieldIds; source matrix rowIds or sorted recordIds define rows. Keep missing/null cells and every source address.
methods.STACK_COLUMNS: Append selected source blocks horizontally, with explicit output coordinates and per-source block dimensions. Independent records displayed at the same row position are not joined. Unequal block heights leave padding outside blocks, not invented source cells.

textSemantics.text: Only plainText/stringList. Join list items in original order with itemSeparator, then cell segments with separator.
textSemantics.canonical: Text unchanged; number uses the exact supported value; boolean true/false; date uses the typed date literal; choices use source snapshot code/label; arrays use itemSeparator in source order.
textSemantics.blankPolicy: Applied to the rendered whole-cell segment after item joining. skip excludes empty/whitespace-only segments without trimming retained content; keep preserves empty segments. Never manufactures a value for a missing cell.
textSemantics.duplicatePolicy: keep retains repeats; distinct compares full rendered segments ordinally and keeps the first occurrence in the explicit order.
textSemantics.limits: Preparation never truncates separator/content. Reducer/storage must chunk full output or fail explicitly at budget; samples and paged result rows cannot be used as full output.

calculationResult.boundary: Internal pure result version 2 only. L5c must wrap with config/generation/catalog identities, persist/hash complete output and implement readers before activation.
calculationResult.sourceSet: Require the complete expected source pin set and its digest. Reject duplicates, missing, extra or changed sources. Reuse full native value validation; no selected or filtered-out error is silently skipped.
calculationResult.numbers: Source and output numeric values are exact invariant strings. SUM uses fixed-scale BigInteger accumulation; AVG returns exact Sum/Count without implicit division or rounding. Numeric state merge requires disjoint authorized source sets.
calculationResult.empty: COUNT and boolean/distinct counts are zero on no present cells; SUM/AVG/MIN/MAX/LATEST have no scalar value without inputs. Missing/null/present and excluded counters remain separate. CONCAT exposes segmentCount even for kept zero-length segments.
calculationResult.text: Concatenate TextChunks by index without adding separators. Literal LF/CRLF/Unicode are preserved. TextSegments identify source cells and ranges in UTF-16 code units across the full concatenation. Format is type-aware; list itemSeparator is independent from inter-cell separator.
calculationResult.stack: Typed cell chunks carry absolute output row/column plus report/table/row-or-record/field source address. Source block dimensions distinguish padding from missing cells inside a block.
calculationResult.budgets: Caller must supply report/group/cell-visit/retained-byte/output-byte/chunk limits; no production quota is inferred from demo caps. Keep complete output within limits or throw. Text chunks split at Unicode scalar boundaries; a typed stack cell exceeding the supplied chunk budget fails explicitly.
calculationResult.merge: Final CONCAT strings, distinct counts and displayed averages are not merge inputs. L5c must combine disjoint numeric Sum/Count or recompute non-additive methods from the deduplicated pinned source set. No current job calls this calculator.

labels: Codes are retained in definition metadata; code-array order follows the existing P8 set canonicalization. The pure compiler has no label lookup/default. P8 v2 resolves visible active label versions, checks type/options and global root/v1/v2 uniqueness, and includes snapshots/dependency pins in hashes.

preparationBounds.meaning: Source preparation safety bounds. Not a production execution budget or permission to increase existing Form/P8/runtime limits.

roundTrip: Strict required/unknown/duplicate-property guards; no automatic v1 migration or config defaults. JSON retains IDs, array order, metadata, literal separators and options. Prepared bindings are detached from the input definition.
digest: BE content digest reuses StatConfigCanonicalJson, including existing label-set canonicalization. It is not a published schema hash, P8 config hash, concurrency token or job pin.
remaining: L5a.1-3 and L5b source are written; compile/runtime/QA/API/DB round-trip verification remains unperformed
L5c must invoke native source capture, persist its order digest, and implement generation/result readers before activation
L5c must configure execution budgets and preserve exact numeric state, text chunks/segment provenance and stack block/cell geometry through storage and readers
L5c native generation/result readers and guarded activation
Execution verification remains unperformed under the user's no-test/build/QA/job constraint
